children: (“ARRAY” or the “Company”), a leading global provider of solar tracking technology and fixed-tilt products, foundation solutions, software systems and services, today announced that members of its senior management and/or investor relations team are scheduled to participate in the following investor conference in December.
UBS Global Technology and AI Conference (Scottsdale)
Attendees: Nick Strevel (Chief Product Officer) and Investor Relations
ARRAY will be conducting meetings with investors in attendance. Interested investors should contact their UBS representative.

is a leading global provider of integrated energy infrastructure for utility-scale and distributed generation providers.
